_comment: Character-consistency variant: conditions generation on a reference image
(a character's approved reference or an earlier scene's image) via IPAdapter,
instead of relying on the text prompt alone to keep faces/clothing consistent.
REQUIRES, in your ComfyUI install:
1. The ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus custom node pack (via ComfyUI Manager or
git clone into custom_nodes/).
2. A CLIP vision model in models/clip_vision/ - for SD1.5 checkpoints use
CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B (rename to clip_vision_h.safetensors, or edit
node 12 below to match your actual filename).
3. An IPAdapter model in models/ipadapter/ matching your checkpoint family
(e.g. ip-adapter-plus_sd15.bin for SD1.5). Edit node 13's ipadapter_file
to match your actual filename.
VERSION NOTE: IPAdapter-Plus has changed its node class names more than once
(older installs expose "IPAdapterApply"; newer ones use "IPAdapter" or
"IPAdapterAdvanced" with a different input set). This template uses the
long-stable "IPAdapterApply" node - if your install is on a newer version
and ComfyUI rejects this workflow with an unknown-node-type error, open
ComfyUI's own node browser, find your installed IPAdapter node's exact
class_type and input names, and update node 14 to match. This template has
not been executed against a live ComfyUI instance as part of building it -
verify it end-to-end before relying on it for a real project.
weight on node 14 controls how strongly the reference influences the
result: 0.5-0.7 typically keeps the character recognisable without
overriding the scene's own pose/lighting/composition from the prompt.
